groups.activity: rank up the current series' tiers
conditions: The Cred Offerings store closes between series and during Intermissions, and unspent Cred converts to a 5,000-credit sellable item when a series ends — buy every beacon you need before then.
As of Update 43.5 the Wolf Beacon is a permanent 50-Cred Offerings item, not on a 7-day rotation.

groups.activity: equip a Wolf Beacon, then kill the Wolf of Saturn Six
conditions: Wolf Beacons only work in missions where assassins can spawn — not Syndicate, Assassination, Sorties, Archwing, free roam, quests, Sanctuary Onslaught, relays, dojos or Uranus underwater missions.
Only one beacon can be used per mission, across the whole squad.
No duplicate protection: expect well over a dozen kills to nail the Motor alone.
The Wolf is immune to status effects and Warframe abilities and dispels active buffs; his three Fugitives can't be damaged while he lives.
He is level-capped at 60 solo and 75 in public squads.
bonuses: Body shots with high critical chance are the play; headshots do 75% less damage since his Sentient hybrid change.
Invisibility (Loki, Ivara Prowl, an Octavia Metronome specter) makes the fight close to trivial, and he can't reach airborne frames like Zephyr, Titania or Hildryn well.
His armor can be stripped despite ignoring Corrosive procs, via Shattering Impact or Sharpened Claws.

disclosures.title: why Steel Path doesn't help
disclosures.body: Steel Path doubles resource and mod drops, but weapon parts are neither, so it does not raise Wolf Sledge's drop chance.

disclosures.title: he doesn't despawn
disclosures.body: The Wolf doesn't despawn on a squad wipe or if the beacon user leaves — you must kill him or fail the mission, so a slow kill at a hard difficulty can cost the whole attempt.
